# Data dictionary: `tax_documents` (contract v1)

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen_docs.py from src/tax_rag/contracts/tax_documents.yml. Do not edit by hand. -->

Tax law and guidance corpus (statutes, regulations, rulings, guidance, FAQs) ingested from the upstream tax-document API, curated in Unity Catalog and chunked for retrieval.

**Owner:** tax-data-platform  
**Default tags:** `contains_pii=false`, `data_classification=public`, `domain=tax`

| Table | Layer | Managed by | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bronze_tax_documents` | bronze | pipeline | Append-only raw API payloads exactly as received. Protected from full refresh so history beyond the API's retention window can always be replayed. |
| `silver_tax_document_events` | silver | pipeline | Every validated document version (append-only change log). Records failing a `drop` quality rule are routed to silver_tax_document_quarantine instead. |
| `silver_tax_document_quarantine` | silver | pipeline | Records that failed at least one `drop` quality rule, with the raw payload for triage. |
| `silver_tax_documents` | silver | pipeline | Current state of every live document (SCD type 1, one row per document_id). Deleted documents are removed. This is the table analysts should query. |
| `silver_tax_documents_history` | silver | pipeline | Full version history (SCD type 2). Use `__START_AT` / `__END_AT` to answer "what did the rule say on date X" audits. |
| `gold_tax_document_chunks` | gold | job | Retrieval-ready chunks of live documents (one row per chunk). Source of the Delta Sync vector search index; Change Data Feed is enabled. |

## `bronze_tax_documents`

Append-only raw API payloads exactly as received. Protected from full refresh so history beyond the API's retention window can always be replayed.

| Column | Type | Description | Tags |
|---|---|---|---|
| `document_id` | `STRING` | Upstream document identifier extracted from the payload (may be null for malformed records). |  |
| `document_version` | `BIGINT` | Upstream monotonically increasing version of the document. |  |
| `updated_at` | `TIMESTAMP` | Upstream last-modified timestamp (UTC); drives incremental polling. |  |
| `payload` | `STRING` | Raw JSON document as returned by the source. | `raw=true` |
| `source_mode` | `STRING` | Ingestion path: api, files or kafka. |  |
| `source_ref` | `STRING` | Lineage pointer: API polling window, file path or kafka topic/partition/offset. |  |
| `fetched_at` | `TIMESTAMP` | When the record was read from the source (UTC). |  |

## `silver_tax_document_events`

Every validated document version (append-only change log). Records failing a `drop` quality rule are routed to silver_tax_document_quarantine instead.

| Column | Type | Description | Tags |
|---|---|---|---|
| `document_id` | `STRING` | Stable upstream identifier of the tax document. | `key=primary` |
| `document_version` | `BIGINT` | Upstream version; higher wins. |  |
| `title` | `STRING` | Document title. |  |
| `document_type` | `STRING` | Normalised type: statute, regulation, ruling, guidance, publication, form_instructions, faq, case_law, other. |  |
| `jurisdiction` | `STRING` | ISO 3166 country or subdivision code, e.g. US, US-CA, DE-BY. |  |
| `tax_type` | `STRING` | Normalised tax type: income, corporate, payroll, sales_use, vat_gst, property, excise, estate_gift, other. |  |
| `tax_year` | `INT` | Tax year the document applies to; null when not year-specific. |  |
| `effective_date` | `DATE` | Date the provision takes effect. |  |
| `expiration_date` | `DATE` | Date the provision stops applying; null when open-ended. |  |
| `source_url` | `STRING` | Canonical URL of the authoritative source. |  |
| `language` | `STRING` | BCP-47 language tag of the body. |  |
| `body_text` | `STRING` | Body converted to normalised plain text. |  |
| `content_hash` | `STRING` | SHA-256 of body_text; detects content changes across versions. |  |
| `is_deleted` | `BOOLEAN` | Tombstone flag; true removes the document downstream. |  |
| `updated_at` | `TIMESTAMP` | Upstream last-modified timestamp (UTC). |  |
| `source_mode` | `STRING` | Ingestion path: api, files or kafka. |  |
| `source_ref` | `STRING` | Lineage pointer back to the bronze record source. |  |
| `fetched_at` | `TIMESTAMP` | When the record was read from the source (UTC). |  |
| `processed_at` | `TIMESTAMP` | When the silver transformation ran (UTC). |  |

## `silver_tax_document_quarantine`

Records that failed at least one `drop` quality rule, with the raw payload for triage.

| Column | Type | Description | Tags |
|---|---|---|---|
| `document_id` | `STRING` | Upstream identifier if present. |  |
| `document_version` | `BIGINT` | Upstream version if present. |  |
| `updated_at` | `TIMESTAMP` | Upstream last-modified timestamp if parseable. |  |
| `failed_rules` | `ARRAY<STRING>` | Names of the quality rules the record violated. |  |
| `payload` | `STRING` | Raw JSON payload from bronze. | `raw=true` |
| `source_mode` | `STRING` | Ingestion path: api, files or kafka. |  |
| `source_ref` | `STRING` | Lineage pointer back to the bronze record source. |  |
| `processed_at` | `TIMESTAMP` | When the record was quarantined (UTC). |  |

## `silver_tax_documents_history`

Full version history (SCD type 2). Use `__START_AT` / `__END_AT` to answer "what did the rule say on date X" audits.

| Column | Type | Description | Tags |
|---|---|---|---|
| `document_id` | `STRING` | Stable upstream identifier of the tax document. |  |
| `document_version` | `BIGINT` | Upstream version of this row. |  |
| `__START_AT` | `STRUCT<document_version: BIGINT, updated_at: TIMESTAMP>` | Sequence value at which this version became current. |  |
| `__END_AT` | `STRUCT<document_version: BIGINT, updated_at: TIMESTAMP>` | Sequence value at which this version was superseded; null if current. |  |

## `gold_tax_document_chunks`

Retrieval-ready chunks of live documents (one row per chunk). Source of the Delta Sync vector search index; Change Data Feed is enabled.

**Table properties:** `delta.enableChangeDataFeed=true`

| Column | Type | Description | Tags |
|---|---|---|---|
| `chunk_id` | `STRING` | Primary key: <document_id>::<chunk_index>. | `key=primary`, `vector_search=primary_key` |
| `document_id` | `STRING` | Parent document identifier. |  |
| `document_version` | `BIGINT` | Document version the chunk was built from. |  |
| `chunk_index` | `INT` | Zero-based position of the chunk within the document. |  |
| `chunk_text` | `STRING` | Metadata header plus chunk body; the embedding source column. | `vector_search=embedding_source` |
| `chunk_hash` | `STRING` | SHA-256 of chunk_text. |  |
| `title` | `STRING` | Parent document title. |  |
| `document_type` | `STRING` | Normalised document type. |  |
| `jurisdiction` | `STRING` | ISO 3166 country or subdivision code. |  |
| `tax_type` | `STRING` | Normalised tax type. |  |
| `tax_year` | `INT` | Tax year the document applies to. |  |
| `effective_date` | `STRING` | ISO-8601 date the provision takes effect (string for vector search filtering). |  |
| `expiration_date` | `STRING` | ISO-8601 date the provision stops applying. |  |
| `source_url` | `STRING` | Canonical URL cited back to users. |  |
| `language` | `STRING` | BCP-47 language tag. |  |
| `updated_at` | `TIMESTAMP` | Upstream last-modified timestamp of the parent version. |  |
| `synced_at` | `TIMESTAMP` | When the chunk was written (UTC). |  |

## Quality rules (`silver_tax_document_events`)

| Rule | Action | Constraint | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| `valid_document_id` | drop | `document_id IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(document_id)) > 0` | Every record must carry an upstream identifier. |
| `valid_document_version` | drop | `document_version IS NOT NULL AND document_version >= 0` | Versions order updates; without one we cannot apply CDC safely. |
| `valid_updated_at` | drop | `updated_at IS NOT NULL` | Required for incremental polling and CDC sequencing. |
| `valid_jurisdiction` | drop | `is_deleted OR jurisdiction IS NOT NULL` | Answers are jurisdiction-specific; an unknown jurisdiction is unusable. |
| `has_body` | drop | `is_deleted OR (body_text IS NOT NULL AND length(body_text) > 0)` | Live documents must have content to index. |
| `valid_effective_window` | drop | `expiration_date IS NULL OR effective_date IS NULL OR expiration_date >= effective_date` | A provision cannot expire before it takes effect. |
| `has_title` | warn | `is_deleted OR (title IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(title)) > 0)` | Titles drive citation quality; missing ones are tolerated but tracked. |
| `has_source_url` | warn | `is_deleted OR source_url IS NOT NULL` | Answers should link to the authoritative source. |

## Change data capture

- Keys: `document_id`
- Sequenced by: `document_version`, `updated_at`
- Delete when: `is_deleted`
- Excluded from current/history tables: `is_deleted`, `source_ref`, `fetched_at`, `processed_at`
